subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

It became a known fact that they most played techno music at every party.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**most**" instead of "**mostly**."
 
• The word "**most**" is incorrect in this context, as it should be an adverb modifying the verb "played".
 
• The correct word should be "**mostly**" to indicate that techno music was played most of the time at every party.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It became a known fact that they **mostly **played techno music at every party."*
